name: 2SA1015
description: Toshiba PNP low-noise AF amplifier, the standard complement to the 2SC1815, used together in complementary and push-pull audio stages. TO-92 pinout is E-C-B (Japanese convention): collector is the center pin. Values are magnitudes; PNP rails are negative.

pins.name: E
pins.description: emitter (leftmost lead, flat face toward you)

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: E-C-B left to right. Collector is the CENTER pin (same physical layout as the 2SC1815 complement). Verified from Toshiba datasheet (1=E, 2=C, 3=B).

typical_application: Low-noise audio-frequency voltage amplifier / driver; PNP partner to the 2SC1815 in complementary and push-pull stages.
gotchas: pinout is E-C-B with COLLECTOR in the CENTER, not base
PNP: all ratings negative; do not read -50V Vceo as a positive limit
tops out at the GR rank (200-400) whereas the NPN 2SC1815 also offers a BL rank; the pair is not gain-symmetric at the high end
marked 'A1015' on the body with the rank letter
